Steph / Lena — quick engineering triage:
- Observed: sustained queue depth increase in FastBank's reserved GPU pool starting ~07:15 PDT. NVidia telemetry shows increased kernel stalls on several nodes hosting FastBank tenants.
- Headroom: current reserved headroom at time of triage ~8% (below our alert threshold of 15%).
- Errors: many 5xx traces correspond to out-of-memory evictions + preemption retries on lower-priority work.

Short-term mitigation enacted (10:05 PDT):
1) We throttled background batch jobs for other tenants on the same physical cluster (non-reserved) to free headroom.
2) Enabled aggressive KV cache reuse for FastBank model variants (reduced token recomputation).
3) Triggered a controlled fallback to a lower-memory quantized model for sub-second inference paths to reduce OOM churn.

Next steps:
- We're running a targeted kernel patch to reduce memory spikes; ETA 45–90 minutes for verification.
- If headroom doesn't recover to >=20% within 2 hours, recommend escalation to dedicated burst capacity (requires approval).

I'll push logs to the shared drive and attach a headroom snapshot.

-David Kim
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
